title: Hearty Dutch Meat Casserole
description: A comforting dish filled with slow-cooked beef and topped with a crispy crust. Serve with a side of steamed vegetables for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the mushrooms, onions, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the quick cooking oats and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Peel and slice the roasted potatoes, then arrange them in a single layer on top of the meat mixture.
Sprinkle the Dutch cheese over the potatoes.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
